# Database interfaces for decoupling database operations

from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from typing import Optional, List, Dict, Any
from info import DATABASE_URI, DATABASE_NAME


class IDatabase(ABC):
    """Interface for database operations"""
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def get_banned(self):
        """Get banned users and chats"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def total_users_count(self):
        """Get total user count"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def get_all_users(self):
        """Get all users"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def total_chat_count(self):
        """Get total chat count"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def get_all_chats(self):
        """Get all chats"""
        pass


class IMediaRepository(ABC):
    """Interface for media repository operations"""
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def save_file(self, media):
        """Save a file to the database"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def get_search_results(self, query, file_type=None, max_results=10, offset=0):
        """Get search results"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def get_file_details(self, query):
        """Get file details by file_id"""
        pass


class IConnectionRepository(ABC):
    """Interface for connection management"""
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def add_connection(self, group_id, user_id):
        """Add a connection"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def active_connection(self, user_id):
        """Get active connection for user"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def all_connections(self, user_id):
        """Get all connections for user"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def if_active(self, user_id, group_id):
        """Check if connection is active"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def delete_connection(self, user_id, group_id):
        """Delete a connection"""
        pass


class IFiltersRepository(ABC):
    """Interface for filter operations"""
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def add_filter(self, grp_id, text, reply_text, btn, file, alert):
        """Add a filter"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def find_filter(self, group_id, name):
        """Find a filter by name"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def get_filters(self, group_id):
        """Get all filters for a group"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def delete_filter(self, message, text, group_id):
        """Delete a filter"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def count_filters(self, group_id):
        """Count filters in a group"""
        pass
